# Source: https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/reference/copilot-vscode-features#_chat-tools
# Last verified: 2026-03-31
#
# Format: one tool identifier per line. Lines starting with # are comments.
# Group headers use ## prefix for readability.
#
# Usage: audit-tools.ps1 reads this file to validate agent tool assignments.
# Update this file when VS Code adds/removes tools or extensions are adopted.
#
# Naming conventions:
#   Built-in:   {category}/{tool}             e.g. read/readFile
#   Extension:  {publisher.ext}/{tool}        e.g. ms-toolsai.jupyter/configureNotebook
#   MCP:        {server-name}/{tool}          e.g. pylance-mcp-server/pylanceImports
